name: MERCURY Inc.
summary: MERCURY, Inc. is in the real estate information platform business through Platform, Digital Marketing and Others divisions. The Platform division provides a SaaS marketing system using real estate databases such as Summarynet and Realnetnavi, Digital Marketing handles internet advertising and property website creation, and Others includes systems development, remodeling and information services for condominium owners. Dating from 1991, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
